summary.en-US: See which posts a real human, verified by ZOREAL, vouched for, and sign what you write. Works on any site. No account in the browser.

version.approval_notes: No account or credentials are needed. Verification runs on any page that carries a ZOREAL Mark: the README at https://github.com/Bynn-Intelligence/zoreal-mark-firefox contains example Marks that render each verdict once the extension is installed. Signing requires the ZOREAL ID app on a phone and is not needed to review verification. The extension loads no remote code. The source archive rebuilds the package with Node 22 or later: npm ci, npm run build. The privacy notice at https://zoreal.com/privacy/mark-extension describes the two requests the extension makes.
